characters.name: As a whole
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job:England's hair in the manga varies with realistic shades of blond (pale straw blond, dirty blond, golden-strawberry blond) but the anime makes it a saturated yellow.Beautiful Worldfixes this, going with the golden blond seen in most manga art.France's hair color in the manga varies between being a golden blond to a darker, almost brown shade. In the anime, it's a bright yellow-blond. The fifth season gives him platinum blond hair.Russia's hair varies between being platinum blond or a golden-dark blond in manga artwork. The anime chose to render his hair in a beige tone (which it originally appeared as in trading card art). His tan scarf is also changed to pink. (Well,pink does fit him.)China has black hair (most of the time) in the manga, but brown in the anime.Canada has lighter blond hair with darker tips in manga artwork, but the anime gives him a uniform dark blond shade. His eyes also changed from being violet (or light blue) to a deep blue. Both changes make him look even more like America. Season 5 gives him back his violet eyes, and changes his hair color to a strawberry blond shade. England's hair in the manga varies with realistic shades of blond (pale straw blond, dirty blond, golden-strawberry blond) but the anime makes it a saturated yellow.Beautiful Worldfixes this, going with the golden blond seen in most manga art. France's hair color in the manga varies between being a golden blond to a darker, almost brown shade. In the anime, it's a bright yellow-blond. The fifth season gives him platinum blond hair. Russia's hair varies between being platinum blond or a golden-dark blond in manga artwork. The anime chose to render his hair in a beige tone (which it originally appeared as in trading card art). His tan scarf is also changed to pink. (Well,pink does fit him.) China has black hair (most of the time) in the manga, but brown in the anime.

characters.name: Northern Italian Republic (Italy Veneziano) — Feliciano Vargas
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: His hair is often colored medium or light brown in manga illustrations, but the anime gives him auburn hair or saturated red hair. Adaptational Wimp: Quite a bit. Italy's performance in World War II was far below than what it should have been capable of on paper, but its record in World War I and other wars is hardly lackluster. And while Italy is portrayed asThe Ditzin this series, real Italians have contributed greatly to academia over thousands of years. Even Machiavelli can't avoid it. Annoying Younger Sibling: This is how Romano sees him, at any rate. Awesome, yet Impractical: During WWII Italy finally gets ahold of a decent, functioning tank (which, beingItaly, is an accomplishment)... that smokes up the inside everytime it fired, so tank crews left the top open during battle.Truth in Television, actually. Big Eater: First there's pasta, then there's that he'll eat so much gelato it'll give him a stomachache...

characters.name: Federal Republic of Germany — Ludwig
characters.description: Affectionate Nickname: Prussia often refers to him as "West", especially after World War II. All Germans Are Nazis: Averted. Germany himself doesn't really agree with hisboss' decisions and he considers him quite crazy, though there are some jokes, especially in the dub.This exchange:Germany:(to Italy)Are you vanting me togasyou?!And also:Romano:Hey there,Hasselhoff!I've got a little surprise for you!Germany:Great. What is it? Another Jew? (It's even censored in aYouTube video.)There is aparodyin which Germany acts like this. Many comments are about how 'Germany's Nazi is showing'. This exchange:Germany:(to Italy)Are you vanting me togasyou?! And also:Romano:Hey there,Hasselhoff!I've got a little surprise for you!Germany:Great. What is it? Another Jew? (It's even censored in aYouTube video.) There is aparodyin which Germany acts like this. Many comments are about how 'Germany's Nazi is showing'.

characters.name: State of Japan — Honda Kiku
characters.description: Apologizes a Lot: As part of his extreme politeness, and especially when he gets flustered. One of hisImage Songsis even calledExcuse Me, I'm Sorry. Asian and Nerdy: Like hisOtakuside, this stereotype isn't brought up that much in regards to him but it clearlydoesapply to him to some extent, considering the couple of strips that show him to be aTeen Genius/Gadgeteer Genius. Asian Fox Spirit: Dresses as akitsuneforfor one Halloween◊. Bathtub Scene: During "America and Japan's Co-Habitation!" inThe Beautiful World. Berserk Button: He doesn't have many and even then it takes him some effort to show anger most of the time.Watching him completely lose his shitwhen hearing that Germany was contemplating an alliance with Russia is quite telling.

characters.name: United States of America — Alfred F. Jones
characters.description: Adventurer Archaeologist: Two of his hobbies are "archaeology" and "adventures". Age Cut: England says goodbye to a little boy America, and returns on his next voyage to find America a nearly fully-grown teenager. The All-American Boy: In personality, America is a bit more abrasive and less wholesome than the mold (and less carefree, but that comes with the territory with actuallybeingAmerica), but he's still very outgoing and willing to help out. He definitely looks the archetype as a blue-eyed blond, at least. Always a Child to Parent: Despite America being fully grown (well, 19 according to canon), England still habitually scolds him like a child and once makes a reference to America wetting the bed. America Saves the Day: He does this quite a lot, always proclaiming himself to be a hero.

characters.name: Russian Federation — Ivan Braginsky
characters.description: The Alcoholic: Vodka is his fuel, after all. Animals Hate Him: Almost every animal in Russia's surroundings reacts... not so well to him. The only exception ishis pet cat. Animate Inanimate Object: Russia's scarf once comes to life and tries tostrangleAmerica. Bait-and-Switch Comment: He does this often during the sudden switch into his "cruel" mode. For instance, he once tells England that he considers America's cockiness a positive trait, and that he very much enjoys his youthful spirit... because people like that are more fun to "snap in half". Beat Still, My Heart: In one strip, Russia's heartfalls out onto the table. Apparently, this is something of a regular occurrence for him.He isn't too bothered; he only blushes and says it "just pops out of me, sometimes."

characters.name: French Republic — Francis Bonnefoy
characters.description: Agent Peacock: Retains many of his flamboyant,campqualities even when he's a hyper-badass. Though it does occasionally backfire (such as his flashy uniform that makes him a prime target). Attractive Bent-Gender: Italy mistook him beingDisguised in Dragfor being a pretty woman once. HisNyotaliacounterpart is also very elegant and fashionable. Aw, Look! They Really Do Love Each Other: France takes care of England when he's ill, and despite aDude, She's Like in a Comamoment, he appears genuinely concerned for England's health. Belligerent Sexual Tension: With England. The fact that they bickerLike an Old Married Coupleis a good hint, as well as the fact that they are incapable ofnotbeing involved in each other's lives, judging by what's been shown of them throughout history. Big Brother Instinct: Considers himself the older brother to all of Europe... except only North Italy and Monaco acknowledge him as such. It's partly in order to divert any suggestion that he's an old man.

characters.name: People's Republic of China — Wang Yao
characters.description: All Chinese People Know Kung-Fu: Actuallyjustified. The characters in Hetalia are personifications of their countries' histories and cultures, and Chinadoeshave a long tradition of martial arts. Asian Rudeness: His propensity for bluntness, and his being somewhat easily annoyed and prone to snapping. Especially so in the dub, of course. Beware the Nice Ones: Push him too far and he'll start smashing wallswith his bare fists and head! Big Fancy House: The"I, Like, Wanna Be Free" manga stripgives us a glimpses of China's living room. It looks like he, Macau and Hong Kong live ina traditional Chinese complex home. Bland-Name Product: Some of these arejustifiedas his cheap knock-offs. The author also thinks China's real-life Hello Kitty dolls have been given aPsychotic Smirk.

characters.name: Canada — Matthew Williams
characters.description: Accidental Misnaming: Canada doesn't seem to be able to get his pet's name right. This situation might be ranging from type C to type F. Apologises a Lot: ...see quote. Badass Longcoat: His parka in his military uniform seems to be one. Bears Are Bad News: Averted, since his pet polar bear Kumajirou might forget who Canada really is, but isn't exactly a bad or evil animal. Beware the Nice Ones: ACourteous Canadianwho's a good tactician at war and very intimidating if you manage to make him mad.There's historical precedent for this trait too.

characters.name: Holy Roman Empire
characters.description: Adorably Precocious Child: He conducts himself in a very serious manner, and then there are his attempts to get the Germanic states to stop fighting. Accidental Pervert: Often ends up accidentally or unknowingly pulling up Chibitalia's skirt, or down Chibitalia's shorts. Anachronism Stew: In the anime, theFraming Devicefor several of the extra Chibitalia stories was Holy Roman Empiredreaming...and then waking up to his alarm clock. In the 16th century. Childhood Friend Romance: With Chibitalia Dogged Nice Guy: Type 1 to Chibitalia.

characters.name: Hungary - Elizabeta Héderváry
characters.description: Action Girl: Arguably the most action-oriented female nation, so far. Action Girlfriend: To Austria, though this overlaps withViolently Protective Girlfriendonce Prussia or France are involved. It's also hinted through canon (and expanded in fanworks) that she's the dominant one in the relationship. Arch-Enemy: At different times to Romania. Badass Adorable/Cute Bruiser/Girly Bruiser: She started fighting when she was a little girl, and was able to take on both PrussiaandAustria successfully. She also avertsChickificationby both not being invincible in her "male" daysandby being shown as physically strong (if noteven stronger) during her "maid" ones. Beware the Nice Ones: This cute and sweet maid brutalizes Prussia's army, watches him get ready to sleep with a spear in hand, and busts down a wall in his home to help out her beloved Austria.

characters.name: Republic of Austria - Roderich Edelstein
characters.description: Aloof BigBrother Mentor:Though he served as Italy's mentor and brother figure when Italy was a child, he was also very strict and cold.Germany refers to him as a brother figure in the recent manga, and while still a little cold he isn'tasstrict. Though he served as Italy's mentor and brother figure when Italy was a child, he was also very strict and cold. Germany refers to him as a brother figure in the recent manga, and while still a little cold he isn'tasstrict. Awesome Anachronistic Apparel: Compared to most of the Nations, he's more often seen in older suits, is even seen in some canon works gardening while in 18th Century attire and almostalwayswears ajabot. Bishōnen: While it could be argued that this applies to a lot of characters,Art Evolutionhits Austria hard in the later manga volumes.

characters.name: Kingdom of Prussia/Teutonic Knights - Gilbert Beilschmidt
characters.description: Air Guitar: Does this with a broom in the anime. And it's glorious. Attention Whore"I really wanna make an appearance. One that will burn the memory of my existence into their hearts." Badass Adorable: Back when he was younger, especially. Badass Boast: A lot of the time, but especially when he tells the story of how he became the leader of the Germanic states and unified Germany. Badass Cape: During the Maria Theresa story arc.

characters.name: Swiss Confederation - Basch Zwingli
characters.description: Aloof Older Brother: Subverted in that heseemsto be this at first glance, but is tender and devoted to Liechtenstein. Captain Obvious: When he and Liechtenstein have a picnic inThe Movie:Switzerland(eating a sandwich): I think...it tasteslike sandwich. Color-Coded Eyes: Has icy green eyes. For his grumpy, impersonal nature to anyone not his sister. His eyes can also be an allusion to the diverse landscape of icy mountains, clear blue lakes and rivers, and the green fields and forests his land is often noted for. Cross-Dressing Voices: In the original Japanese. Averted in the dub. Doting Adoptive Brother: He may not seem it at first, due to his aloof nature, but he's shown taking care of Liechtenstein to the point of giving her his food when he didn't have enough to eat for himself. He also buys her a ribbon when apasserby mistook her for a boywhich obviously upset her, and we know how stingy this guy is.

characters.name: Principality of Liechtenstein
characters.description: Big Brother Worship: While they'reNot Blood Siblings, little LiechtensteinadoresSwitzerland. Dying AloneandDeath by Despair: Thanks to Switzerland, she barely escaped from this.I Owe You My Life: Predictably, Liechtenstein is very grateful to her brother and thinks he definitely saved her. I Owe You My Life: Predictably, Liechtenstein is very grateful to her brother and thinks he definitely saved her. Girlish Pigtails: She wore her hair in like this in two braids before herImportant Haircut. The Gunslinger: She has been occasionally shown in some sort of military training with Switzerland carrying a rifle on her back.

characters.name: Czech Republic/Czechia
characters.description: Bratty Half-Pint: Was "tactless and rude" (in Slovakia's words) as a child, and enjoyed rubbing her successes in his face. Hidden Depths: Czechia is said to be quite the artist, probably an allusion to the composersAntonín DvořákandBedřich Smetanaor the painter/designerAlfons Maria Mucha. Noblewoman's Laugh: Tends to laugh"Oh ho ho ho!" The Rival: Toward Hungary where spas are concerned, though Hungary doesn't reciprocate. Silly Reason for War: What Czech thinks of the conflict between her and Slovakia caused by the lack of a hyphen in "Czechoslovakia."

characters.name: Slovak Republic/Slovakia
characters.description: Always Someone Better: Czech Republic was this to him when they were children. Delinquents:Played for Laughswhen Slovakia threatens to become one if Czech doesn't add a hyphen to their shared name. She refuses. Determinator: He's adamant about that hyphen. His character profile mentions that he gets "strangely obsessed" over "odd little things." The Glomp: Does this to Czech after she admits to missing him after their separation (ina roundabout way). Manchild: Shows signs of this, from his rather irresponsible and flighty nature, to the fact that he panics that Czech "did a lot for him" when he fails to make toast after their separation.

characters.name: Kingdom of Belgium
characters.description: Action Girl: A popular portrayal in the fandom. Having aBFGcertainly helps. May also fall underCute BruiserorBadass Adorable. Best Her to Bed Her: Similarly toMonaco, in a request in the 2013 Halloween event, Belgium agrees to let Italy bury his head in her chest... if he can make a better waffle than she can.He gives up. Beware the Nice Ones: Her profile in the third volume describes her as being scary when she's mad. BFG: In some sketches, Belgium is seen handlingquite a big rifle. Big Eater: Hinted at, but she seems to really love food.It doesn't hurt that Belgium has been described as a country of gourmands.

characters.name: Kingdom of the Netherlands
characters.description: Aloof Big Brother: To Belgium and Luxembourg, but they don't seem to mind. Anime Hair: As far as this series goes, his spiky hair stands out as one of the odder hairstyles.Justified Trope, as inReal Lifethat hairstyle is rather common in the Netherlands. Badass Longcoat: With his military uniform. Battle Aura: He seems to gain one while doing business.Or around Spain. Big Brother Mentor: Taught Belgium and Luxembourg a lot about trade and making money, in his own slightly detached way.

characters.name: Grand Duchy of Luxembourg
characters.description: The Alcoholic: Perhaps; he's mentioned as being the world's top drinker in afootnotein theWordy Nordic Comic. Big Brother Worship: Hereallyadmires the Netherlands, and emulates his ways to get rich. He even tried to style his hair like the Netherlands' hair at one point. Big Little Brother: He's shown to be taller than Belgium. Bishie Sparkle: In the one discarded sketch with his face, and also when learning trade strategies from the Netherlands.Belgium's weird dream about a fake Luxembourg hasrosesall around him. Belgium's weird dream about a fake Luxembourg hasrosesall around him.

characters.name: Scotland
characters.description: Aloof Big Brother: Acts mostly aloof towards his other siblings, though acts meaner towards England. Everything's Louder with Bagpipes: In one strip, he trolls England by playing the bagpipe. The Gadfly: When not yelling at England, he loves to mess with him in various ways. In one instance, he once refused to trim the lawn on England's side of the border out of spite. I Just Want to Be Free: Is very vocal about wanting his independence and joining the European Union. Idiot Hair: Has a very curvy one on top of his head. Later artworks depict it more in the shape of a halo.

characters.name: Northern Ireland
characters.description: The Ditherer: Can't seem to make up his mind on certain issues sometimes. This is best demonstrated during the Brexit story arc which had him wondering whether to leave the European Union with England or stay like Scotland wants. Fiery Redhead: Has dark red hair and isn't shy about his opinions. Fighting Irish: Downplayed in that while Northern Ireland isn't pleased over being negatively compared to England, he's not as angered about it like Scotland. Hot-Blooded: Subverted. He initially comes off as the most boisterous and energetic brother, but is actually rather laidback. No, You Hang Up First: According to his profile, he has a tendency to do this when talking on the phone.

characters.name: Wales
characters.description: Big Brother Mentor: Acts as one for England when it comes to magic. Big Brother Worship: Wants to monopolize England's attention to the point of siding with him on Brexit. Black Magic: Much of the folklore and myths associated with England actually come from Wales which partially explains the latter's not-so-ideal relationship with the former. Fairy Tale: This is his main schtick. Interspecies Friendship: Like England, Wales is sometimes depicted with mythical or folklore creatures near him. He has a particular preference for dragons.

characters.name: Republic of Ireland
characters.description: Don't Split Us Up: He did not take being separated from Northern Ireland very well at all. Fiery Redhead: Like Northern Ireland, he has red hair and is quite boisterous in his own opinions. Interspecies Friendship: Like the others, Ireland is friends with a mythical creature, in this case, a leprechaun. NO INDOOR VOICE: His voice is said to be "kind of loud". Talking in Your Sleep: Ireland has a tendency to involuntary summon a leprechaun in his sleep when stressed or worried.

characters.name: Kingdom of Spain - Antonio Fernandez Carriedo
characters.description: Accidental Pervert: When he tugs on Romano's haircurl not understanding whatit does to him. But Spain does show hints of being aCovert Pervert. Big Damn Heroes: Spain pulls aPapa Wolfand rescues South Italy from Turkey. Then, Turkey declares war and Spain almost goes bankrupt funding the war effort. Dashing Hispanic: Downplayed. It is heavily implied that he has traces of this, especially during his imperial days, but he's a more optimistic and easygoing person. Doting Parent: Too bad Romano slaps him in the face every time Spain tries to be nice. Fruit of the Loon: "Nice bananas."

characters.name: Southern Italian Republic (Italy Romano) - Lovino Vargas
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: He has green eyesnoteThough they also tend to be colored hazel or a light brown colorin the manga, while the first four seasons of the anime gave him golden eyes, and made his hair darker than in the manga.Beautiful Worldchanged them back to green and lightened up his hair again. Attack Hello: His favorite method of waking up Spain as Chibiromano. Berserk Button: JustseeingGermany is enough to set him off. Big Brother Bully: He's often verbally abusive to the younger Italy, at least, he keeps shoving his northern counterpart and tells him to shut up. Big Brother Instinct: He utterlyhatesGermany because of Germany'sconnection to Italy. This doesn't stop himbothering younger Italy himself, or even pretending his little brother doesn't exist sometimes.

characters.name: Principality of Monaco
characters.description: Action Girl: Possibly. She is drawn wearing what appears to be chain mail and coif in some concept sketches in the third volume. Art Shift: Comparing her early sketches to her more recent appearances, she looks a lot younger now with a much sleeker braid. Yeah Best Her to Bed Her: A variation. You have to beat her in poker to date her.She might make an exception once in a while, though.In the 2013 Halloween Italy tried to win against her so he couldrest his head on her chest. Shestrips him naked. In the 2013 Halloween Italy tried to win against her so he couldrest his head on her chest. Shestrips him naked. Brainy Brunette: Subverted, she was initially a brunette but it seems she's now a blue-eyed blonde, via the notes given on her in the volume 3 special edition.Apparently, in the last profile picture Himaruya took a third option and gave her dark blonde hair, which can be seen as light brown too.Hair Color Dissonance: Is it dark brown, light brown, dirty blond or platinum blond?

characters.name: Portuguese Republic
characters.description: Blackmail: The "foolish stories" he knows comes off as this. Romano complains that Spain becomes much meeker around Portugal.Portugal:I know so many foolish stories about this guy, there's no way he can ever say no to me. Establishing Character Moment: Appearing before Spain and Romano, saying "Boa noite"Translation"Good evening" or "Good night"and saying he knows a lot offoolish storiesinvolving Spain, which makes Spain feel uncomfortable. Goggles Do Nothing: He wears some "badass goggles" with his uniform. Hopeless with Tech: As a result of him being late to industrialize. Heterosexual Life-Partners:England and Portugal have a deep bond, as perWord of God. Theydohave the oldest living alliance with the Windsor Treaty.He and Macau were close friends and trading partners even before they became boss and underling. Portugal fought and defeated the Netherlands to keep Macau with him.

characters.name: Hellenic Republic — Heracles Karpusi
characters.description: Ambiguously Related: It's possible that he's Rome's son — they share the same hair colour, while his mother has black hair and is referred to as Rome's wife. By extension, this could mean he's related to the Italy brothers. Attack of the 50-Foot Whatever: As seen inthis strip, Greece has a movie about agigantic moussakaattacking. Berserk Button:Turkey's mere presence pisses him off.This seems to extend to TRNC as well if the Drama CD is anything to go by, since he threatens todisownCyprus if he continues interacting with TRNC. Turkey's mere presence pisses him off. This seems to extend to TRNC as well if the Drama CD is anything to go by, since he threatens todisownCyprus if he continues interacting with TRNC.

characters.name: Republic of Turkey/Ottoman Empire — Sadik Adnan
characters.description: The Alcoholic: Well, hedidspend most of theHetalia Bloodbath 2010drunk.Unless...Ironically enough, mostly due to Islam's religious restrictions, Turkey's alcohol consumption is thelowestin Europe. AcCENT upon the Wrong SylLABle: Tends to do this in the dub. Boisterous Bruiser: Was gung-ho about invading Europe during his Ottoman Empire days, and even nowadays is quite loud about his opinions. Child Hater: "I really hate kids!", afterChibitaliakicks him in the face and little Greece "welcomes" him home with a smile. Crazy Jealous Guy: He becomes incensed upon seeing Japan with Greece in one manga chapter and jumps to the assumption that Greece is "trying to invade Japan", even claiming that "Ya don't know how well Japan and I get along!" He even threatens to invade France if he tries to harass Japan his usual way.

characters.name: Republic of Cyprus
characters.description: Badass Pacifist: In the Drama CD and theHetalia Bloodbath 2011, he is averyNice Guy, but when Turkey and Greece push his limits, he blows up at them and gives them a good talking-to about their people living in peace. In his comic cameo, he demands from Greece to try getting along with Turkey. Berserk Button: Greece and Turkey fighting is enough to make him lose his cool. The Cameo: He does a cameo in aGreece and Turkey strip. Fashionable Asymmetry: One side of his hair ismuchlonger than the other, and he's quite cute. Nice Guy: Normally very peaceful and easygoing.

characters.name: Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus (TRNC)
characters.description: Big Brother Worship: Anddon't you dare to talk badly about Turkeyin his presence. Berserk Button: Talking badly about Turkey... and he'snota micronation. Not Growing Up Sucks: He can't grow up because he's only been recognized as a country by Turkey, according to the Drama CD. Perpetual Frowner: Very serious. The Rival: To Sealand, since TRNC's at least been recognized by Turkey, while Sealand isn't recognized by anyone.

characters.name: Republic of Bulgaria
characters.description: Bishie Sparkle: When posing with his stick, and again with hisAttack on Titanjacket in the Hetaween 2013 event. Cloud Cuckoolander: Possible characterization since he randomly decides to smack Italy after France and England do, and the only photo of him in his military clothes has him posing for the shot. Early Installment Character-Design Difference: In his first appearance (in both the manga and anime), he was drawn with hisEyes Always Shut. He's had fully open eyes in every appearance since. Heroic Self-Deprecation: His ill-fated attempt at cheering up Romania:Romania:Anyway, it's no good; I'm a huge disappointment even to myself...Bulgaria:A disappointment?! Who cares?! We're totally the top 2 by a wide margin in the ranking of biggest disappointments in the EU! Improbable Weapon User: He likes using a stick:Bulgaria:Once I get a stick in my hand, I start to tingle with excitement!

characters.name: Romania
characters.description: Big Brother Instinct: Towards Moldova, to the point that he gets depressed and feels like a failure when Moldova refers to Russia as "big brother." Black Magic: His first appearance is in the background of theGakuen Hetaliamagic club.Spells and black magic are his specialty.He's a merry oddball. Fortune Teller: With Tarot cards. Hair Color Dissonance: Is he a brunet, a dark blond, or a redhead? Most artists choose the middle option, though strawberry blond could hint at the Strigoi, a bloodsucking reanimated corpse that is said to have red(dish) hair and blue eyes. Meaningful Name: "Romania" means "Land of Romans." He's a huge fan of Ancient Rome, and considers himself to be descended from him (though Romano vehemently disagrees).

characters.name: Republic of Moldova
characters.description: Adorably Precocious Child: Mentioned in his profile that he's a hard-working boy and more patient when compared with the Micronation kids. Cheerful Child: Most of the time. When Russia is around, however... Empty Eyes: Gets these around Russia. Freudian Slip: Combined with aLast-Second Word Swap.Russia:You're adorable, Moldova. I'd be happy if you'd call me 'big brother.'Moldova:That would be way too terrify — um, terrific, Mr. Russia. Um, I mean... Big Brother Russia... Nerves of Steel: In the 2013 Hetaween event, he mentions that he has a high tolerance for terror.

characters.name: Republic of Croatia
characters.description: Dull Surprise: Upon being immediately accepted intoThe European Union.That was quick... Se ya around! Former Teen Rebel: "For a while, he had dark circles under his eyes and was an outlaw, but after he started to emphasize on tourism, he began to care more about his appearance". Sweet Tooth:The Licitar gingerbreadis hisTrademark Favorite Food. Tearful Smile: He has a very pleasing, serene, eyes-half-closed smile that's almost melancholic.

characters.name: Republic of Estonia - Eduard von Bock
characters.description: All Just a Dream: He's relieved that he wasn'treallysent to a dimension where everyone's gender was reversed... Author Avatar: Himaruya had once mentioned that he's the closest to Estonia based on looks and personality. It would certainly explain why all theweird stuffhappens to him... The Beast Master: Sort-of... if you count the Mochis as his pets.Badly Battered Babysitter: These mochis are, well, very unruly... Badly Battered Babysitter: These mochis are, well, very unruly... Big Brother Instinct: TowardsLATVIAAAAAAAAAA!!!!

characters.name: Republic of Latvia - Raivis Galante
characters.description: The Alcoholic: According to some notes and the desktop mascots. Despite being too young to drink in human age. And Call Him "George": Russia's fondness of crushing head pats, and his idea of "playing" with Latvia involves stretching him bodily. Big Brother Mentor: Subverted in that Latviatriesto act as one toward Sealand, only to break out in tears when thinking about his own history. Sealand ends up having to comforthim. Bookworm: He loves reading poetry and romance novels. Cloudcuckoolander's Minder: He acts as something of a grounding influence to Sealand.

characters.name: Republic of Lithuania - Toris Laurinaitis
characters.description: Apologises a Lot: InHetalia Bloodbath 2010, to the point of not even listening to what Poland was trying to tell him through the phone. Big Brother Instinct: From his Volume 5 profile: "He likes to look after others, he's like a big brother figure!" Brainy Brunet: One of the very few dark-haired Northern European countries (and the only one a consistent brunet - Hungary, Netherlands and Belgium have been depicted as blonds in some art, while Lithuania never has) and often noted to be intelligent, especially next toDumb BlondPoland. Russia even says "you look smart" to Lithuania before dragging him away after the partitions of Poland. Characterization Marches On: Who was the first person to use the word "fantabulous" in a sentence? Not Poland.Lithuania. Clark Kent Outfit: He's actually quite muscular.

characters.name: Republic of Poland - Feliks Łukasiewicz
characters.description: Agent Peacock: He's small, effeminate, and flamboyant; likes ponies, pink, and fancy clothes; and sometimes wears ribbons and skirts. He has also controlled Middle and Eastern Europe, revived after each time he's been partitioned, and can still stand up to Russia, acting as Lithuania's protector. All Girls Like Ponies: Gender-inverted example as he appears fond of them when he bought a ton of ponies for military used but decided to keep one as a pet. Attention Deficit... Ooh, Shiny!: InHetaween 2011, he tried to bring a horse to the party, and then spends the entire time sitting on a toy horse, running after butterflies, looking at flowers and being generally distracted before falling asleep, still on his toy horse. Calvinball: When playingChess:Poland:I'll invokePoland's rule! It'll always be my turn! Character Development: Starts off asveryselfish and childish, starts to mature later. He's one of the few who stand up to Russia, after all, and does so to protect Lithuania.

characters.name: Republic of Belarus - Natalia Arlovskaya
characters.description: Abhorrent Admirer: Oh, Russia. Of course, he acknowledges that his little sister is a very pretty girl - it's just her knife nut tendencies that make her abhorrent...and of course the fact she's in love with her ownbrother. Action Girl: She is almost always seen dual-wielding that knife of hers and is one of the most "active" girls. She may cross or be pretty close to crossing the border intoDark Action Girl, due to her attitude. Annoying Younger Sibling: Not only to Russia and Ukraine, but according tosome manga notes, America also views her like this since he had to take care of her for a while. Big Brother Attraction: Has a seriously big crush on Russia and often stalks him. Bitch Alert: She may have Russia's cruelty, but unlike him, she doesn't mask it at all.

characters.name: Ukraine
characters.description: Action Girl: Carries a saber in a sketch of her military uniform, possibly hinting at some hiddenLady of Wartendencies. Badass Longcoat: Her military uniform includes a jacket that goes past her knees. Beware the Nice Ones: From one of her profiles: "She may look like a crybaby, but is in fact Russia's fearsome sisterwho will stand her ground to the last." Her recent appearance in chapter 389 of World Stars hints at an unhinged side of her. Bifauxnen: In Hetaween 2011 she was drawn in aMadHattercostumeand, while she still looks obviously female, she pulls off the lookverywell. She also dresses as a ghost train conductor in Hetaween 2013. She's...even more obviously femalethere. Boyish Short Hair: She has the looks, although she does dress it up a bit. It contrasts with her younger sister'smuch longer hair andstyle of dress.

characters.name: Republic of Finland — Tino Väinämöinen
characters.description: The country known for the aurora and rumoured to be where Santa lives. Specializes in agriculture and forestry, high-tech machinery, as well as a variety of talented people. Was once the underling of Sweden and Russia but was able to gain independence after fighting with these larger nations and is now working hard. Also loves interesting festivals; every year he'd think of weird festivals that no other countries can even imagine. A gentle young man with simplistic tenacity. He seems very adult-like, and if you start talking with him it’ll last forever. But even though this guy appears to be all soft and mellow, you won't want to mess with him; even if he lets you poke him up to ten times, any more than that and he'll return it many times over. He’s strangely strong in the cold, but he also loves saunas. He likes and looks up to Sweden, and also has a rather unique taste in things. Beware the Nice Ones: "Even though he appears to be all soft and mellow, you won't want to mess with him!" Boisterous,Cute Bruiser: If you read the strip referring to thePolish-Swedish war, you'll notice that Finland isquite eager and happy to get into battle, literallycryingbecause Sweden called off the battle. Christmas in July: His version of Hatafutte Parade was released at the end of June, so it has a certain element of this. Additionally, he mentions that he can't wait for Christmas in his cameo in the movie; the movie was released in June 2010 in Japan (the joke also works for the UK DVD release, in which it came out in June 2012).

characters.name: Kingdom of Sweden — Berwald Oxenstierna
characters.description: Formerly a Viking that was known as the Lion of Northern Europe, Conqueror of the Baltic Sea, and even the Supreme Ruler of Scandinavia, but nowadays he's calmed down and put a lot of strength into welfare. A quiet, methodical guy with an intimidating air and is difficult to understand. On the inside, he's kind and rather playful, but many people fear him because of his intimidating air and that no ones knows what he's thinking. He likes debates and making furniture and decorative arts. BFS: His weapon is a two-hand sword. Creepy,Icy Blue Eyes: His eyes give off a cold, piercing vibe to anyone who first meets him. Death Glare: Although it's pretty muchhis normalfacial expression, whether he likes it or not.

characters.name: Kingdom of Denmark
characters.description: He is the fireball of energy of Northern Europe! A powerful big brother who, in the old days, was full of guts and fought with Sweden! Today, he's come to calm down considerably, and puts his strength into social services, organic products, and making furniture. He's optimistic and easy-going, and is the liveliest of the Nordics. Sometimes so lively that it irritates the other nations or gets himself into trouble. This is where he differs from Norway's soft side, where Norway has a bit of a secretive streak in the fact that he is interested in magic, while Denmark just about has a nice side, and likes stories with happy endings. He is also somewhat arrogant, to the point of being bossy sometimes. Arrow Catch: He did this whenBelarusthrew aclothes hangerat him for mouthing off that his group will likely win the costume contest. Of course, Denmark and Finland justlooked forward to everyone doing their best. Beneath the Mask: According toWord of God, he's much different than how he appears. More specifically, it's said that while he appears to be carefree, he's actually very hardworking. Big Brother Instinct: Considers himself the older brother to all of the Nordics and acts like it, much to Norway's annoyance where Iceland is concerned.

characters.name: Kingdom of Norway
characters.description: A young man with a mysterious aura and can see fairies and ghosts. He speaks very little and appears like he's not concerned about the world's problems. He always gets into a fight with his little brother Iceland over mackerels. His hobby is poking at Denmark in a strange way. All Trolls Are Different: He has a gigantic green troll that appears to defend his master if needed. Norway even remarks how his friends are stronger than England's. The Beastmaster: He can send his fairy friends to do his bidding; he does so when he tries to get Iceland to call him "big brother", and again inWorld☆Starswhen he wants Iceland to tell him what's bothering him.Iceland:(being harassed by Boyg)Okay, fine! If I tell you, will you stop pestering me?!Finland:Huh? What happened all of a sudden, Ice?!Norway:(striking a dramatic pose)That is the power of the bond between brothers. Big Brother Instinct: Towards Iceland. He even demands Iceland call him "brother" in one strip, like the quote above states. Exaggerated in the anime with him evenwhispering the requestin Iceland's ear.It gets to the point where he gets annoyed whenever Denmark acts like a big brother toward Iceland.Norway (to Denmark):Stop acting all big brother like that.Doting Big Brother: Iceland remarks that Norway is always "needlessly attentive" toward him. It gets to the point where he gets annoyed whenever Denmark acts like a big brother toward Iceland.Norway (to Denmark):Stop acting all big brother like that.

characters.name: Republic of Iceland
characters.description: A mysterious boy with a cool exterior and a hot interior. He tries to act mature, but he still has an immature side. He is cleverly turning the hot water that is found in his country into spas to attract more tourists. Awkwardly Gay Dream: Icelandonce had a dreamwhere he was flying through the air with Turkey while the latter was only wearing boxer shorts, his mask, and a Santa hat. His reaction when he woke up:"Am I completely mental to be dreaming dreams like this?" Bait-and-Switch: "What? Where you expecting something?" Bratty Teenage Daughter:Gender-Inverted Trope. His immature side isa mild version of this. Brick Joke: In the opening ofThe Movie, Iceland wonders aloud how he can get more tourists to go to his place.And at the end, duringThe Stinger, it turns out he got some of the aliens to stay (somehow) and was using them to attract tourists.

characters.name: Republic of Cuba
characters.description: Accent Adaptation: Speaks with a Kawachi accent, a rougher variation of the Osaka accent. Curiously enough, Cuban Spanish inReal Lifeis the Spanish-language version of this stereotype. Animal-Eared Headband: He wears bunny ears inHetaween 2011while insisting they look cute on him. Batter Up!: He loves sports (especially baseball) and when he holds a bat he becomes moreHot-Bloodedthan usual. Big Beautiful Man: Has some rather dedicated fangirls who love himbecausehe's big and chubby. The Big Guy: Big, strong, tough and friendly.

characters.name: Republic of Ecuador
characters.description: Friend to All Living Things: In his first two pictures, he's seen picking a turtle and smiling and standing alongside an alpaca.

characters.name: Federative Republic of Brazil
characters.description: Hot-Blooded: If his first introduction in the "Gangsta" comic is to be believed. Mr. Fanservice: His first appearance shows him in a tank top and loose jacket combo that shows off his arms. His shirt also has a suspicious tendency to fly up slightly, showing a bit of his abs. Shark-Toothed Humanoid: Sports these, but Brazil is mostly human in appearance and temperament.

characters.name: Republic of Korea (South Korea) — Im Yong Soo
characters.description: Adapted Out: In the animated series and merchandise, due to real life controversy about Japan and South Korea during and after the Second World War era. Adaptation Dye-Job: He supposed to have chestnut brown hair in the anime series. Himaruya usually depicts him with black hair or a very dark shade of brown. All Love Is Unrequited: Korea'sincestuous affectiontowards China is not returnedat all. He's not much luckier when he tries to pursue Japan, either. But somehow, his is the luckiest with Taiwan. Annoying Younger Sibling: TobothChina and Japan; he's loud, obnoxious, and says thattheyshould callhimtheir older brother. Artistic License – History: In real life (though not well-known), through the records available, China and Korea are assumed to have similar age, and Japan is regarded as youngest among them. Therefore, Japan being older brother to Korea seems far-fetched, while China being older is understandable.

characters.name: Republic of China (Taiwan)
characters.description: A-Cup Angst: Despite not being as flat-chested asLiechtenstein, she does fret about about seeing the Western girls' cleavage during the 2011 Bloodbath. Anime Chinese Girl: Sports this look and plays it up for all its worth. Asian and Nerdy: She is, obviously, Taiwanese, and she's an anime fan who's into cosplay. Bathing Beauty: One strip implies that bothshe and Hungary◊are this. Explained by therich Taiwanese hot spring culture. In her character song, she outright references her many hot springs. Bratty Teenage Daughter: One of the earlier Himaruya sketches has her poking China on the cheek and demanding that he leaves Japan alone, while saying the quote above. In China's drama CD track, she teases him alot, (and according to her profile, one of her hobbiesisannoying China):Taiwan:(giggles)Teacher's going crazy!China:I told you! I'm young, cool, and hip!

characters.name: Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China
characters.description: Annoying Younger Sibling: Makes several digs against China, like showcasing how he knows exactly what China will wear or do at any given time and constantly referring to him as old in spite of China's indignant protests. "Annoying China" is even listed as one of his hobbies. According to one of his profiles, he's also this to England:His hobbies include annoying England and China whenever he sees them! Born Lucky: Apparently, it'snota good idea to place bets against him.Doubleif it involves China, since HK knows him way too well.Taiwan and Macau:We can't win against Hong Kong! Brass Balls: During the 2010 Christmas Bloodbath, China utters this immortal line to Hong Kong:"Choosing to go naked rather than wear a maid outfit? ....YOU'VE GOT BALLS-ARU!!" Brits Love Tea: Zig-zagged.Hong Kong explicitly mentions learning about afternoon "high tea" from England, and the local silk-stocking milk tea is historically inspired by British tea. On the other hand, Hong Kong is alsobacked with traditional Chinese teas(inyum cha, i.e. morning dim sum with tea). All of this isTruth in Television.Hong Kong's very existencedeconstructsthe trope historically. The First Opium War was fought because the Chinese were sick of the Brits getting their people addicted to opium, which was in turn caused by British tea mania.noteTo be more specific, Qing-dynasty China only accepted silver as currency in foreign trade, and the UK depleted their entire coffers of silver for tea... and when they ran out, the Brits grew opium in what is now India to sell to Qing China for silver, which theythenexchanged for tea. The Chinese ended up dumping a huge stock of opium into the sea, the Brits got mad, eventually a war happened and China lost and have to give up Hong Kong to the British Empire. Well, that's the short summary, at least.AndHetalia-wise, China'sVerbal Ticwhen speaking to England specifically isahen, whichmeans"opium"... Hong Kong explicitly mentions learning about afternoon "high tea" from En

characters.name: Macau Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: After discussing how he is aNice Guy, as mentioned below, his profile follows up with this:He seems to also have another side, another part, lol.In one strip, he is ratherpassive aggressivetowards China when the latter asks for his help with keeping Hong Kong from wanting independence. Big Brother Instinct: Seems relatively protective over the younger Asian countries, escorting Taiwan to the party and attempting to help Vietnamcover upin the 2013 Halloween event. He also tells Portugal he's always thought of Hong Kong as a younger brother. Big Little Brother: While his age is unclear, he's most likely younger thanChina... but he's stillOne Head Tallerand probably the tallest of the Asians (as is his Nyotalia counterpart). Drink-Based Characterization/Asians Love Tea: He's shown with a tea cup quite often and drinks it while listening to his siblings fighting. The Gambler: Macau is described to be gambling quietly in a dimly lit room in a character note. Considering the city has areputationfor being the Vegas of the East, this isjustified.

characters.name: Mongolia
characters.description: Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Hasn't reappeared since his volume 4 appearance. The Faceless: Appears in Volume Four of the manga as a child, but only in silhouette. No-Sell: He's completely unaffected by General Winter, since he's used to the cold. The Rival: Of Hungary, whom he attacked and bullied as a child according tosome sketches. The Speechless/The Voiceless: His one line in his cameo is "........!"

characters.name: Tibet
characters.description: The Cameo: Shows up in the strip detailing Japan and China'sBackstory. Chuck Cunningham Syndrome: Has only appeared in a single scene so far, and only in the comic. The anime replaced him with a panda, probably to avoid controversy. The Speechless/The Voiceless: Doesn't get any lines in his cameo.

characters.name: Socialist Republic of Vietnam
characters.description: Aloof Dark-Haired Girl: One manga illustration makes her look very pretty and a little aloof when in heráo dài. When in the presence of her Southeast Asian colleagues, she's also far more bewildered and exasperated by their antics. Asian and Nerdy:A gamer, indeed. She was showed playingUncharted 3: Drake's Deceptionin asketch on Himaruya's blog. Beware the Nice Ones: Based onher true history, we know that many powerful forces such as America, China, France, Mongolia Empire, etc. have learnt their lesson. Seems to live up to this during theHetalia Bloodbath 2011where she takes charge of the girls' meeting. Brainy Brunette:She's been using her natural creative skillfulness in building new things. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: She may have been hinted to be this during the Halloween Event where she shows up dressed asVietnamese robot Topio. And wins.

characters.name: Kingdom of Thailand
characters.description: Anime Hair: As you can see from his image depiction... Bare-Fisted Monk: In fanon, due to Thailand being the "home" of the very brutal fighting style known asMuay Thai. According to Himaruya, if someone gets on Thailand's bad side, he'll slowly take on a Muay Thai stance. Big Little Brother: Played with, as out of all China's "siblings", he's the only one that seems to have no blood relation to China. The Beastmaster: Has a pet elephant named Toto, whom he dotes on like crazy. Beware the Nice Ones: According to whatHimaruyaonce wrote in his blog, only 99% of him is calm.invoked

characters.name: Republic of India
characters.description: Big Ol' Eyebrows: Only slightly bigger than normal, a lot closer to Hong Kong's "curse." Though like Korea's, they may be unrelated to England's. Bollywood Nerd: According to his profile, he's good with numbers and logical thinking. It may be a reference toRamanujan. Dance of Romance: How a part of the fandomimmediatelyinterpreted his andPrussia's dancing scene inHetaween 2011. Facial Markings: Histilaka. Gentleman and a Scholar: His character profile describes him of having a "princely aura", as well as beingGood with Numbersand having a sensible character.

characters.name: Republic of the Philippines
characters.description: The Alcoholic: Implied to be one after doing a selfie with bottles of beer right beside him. Attention Whore: Loves being the center of attention just like America. As demonstrated in the ASEAN-centric chapters, he'll try to dominate or steer the conversation to what he likes to talk about, whether it is asking Italy about what his favorite food in his place is or butting into Indonesia and Malaysia's conversation to talk about his muscles. Bishie Sparkle: Happens whenever he poses for a selfie. Brutal Honesty: Tends to do this with a smile on his face. Examples include his accidental insult of Thailand by cheerfully mentioning his flaws and affectionately telling Malaysia he's annoying right to his face. The Ditz: As the most energetic, cheerful, and impulsive member, there are times when the other ASEAN members have to rein him in, a trait reminiscent of America. One strip shows him either ignoring or not reading the atmosphere as a flustered Indonesia tries to stop him from riling Thailand.Philippines:That's totally Thailand! The so called land of smiles is actually buff and is good at gambling and scary when angr–Thailand:Hmmm?Indonesia:Philippines, that's enough! O-oh no...

characters.name: Republic of Indonesia
characters.description: Badass Biker: Fits well with hisCool Shades. He was the only member to arrive in the ASEAN meeting via motorcycle, which also represents the proliferation of motorcycles as a local staple of transportation. Cloudcuckoolander's Minder: Is this towards the Philippines, who is basicallyFun PersonifiedandThe Gadfly, and Malaysia, who is aCloud Cuckoo Lander. Deadpan Snarker: Is shown to be rather snarky at times, especially when Malaysia does something to annoy him. Flower Motifs: A pinkish, purpleAnggrek BulannoteMoon Orchid in Englishthat he wore as a brooch. In real life, Moon Orchid is also known as the "flower of charm"notepuspa pesonain Indonesiabecause it is also one of the three Indonesian national flower emblems. Hunk: Has a handsome face and well-built frame.

characters.name: Republic of Singapore
characters.description: Aloof Big Brother: Is an age-inverted version of this towards Malaysia, not wanting to put up with his antics. Deadpan Snarker:Especiallywhen Malaysia is concerned. During their first chapter together, Singapore sarcastically claims to be a different country upon being spoken to by him. The Fashionista: Said to be fashionable, to the point he's involved in his country's business commercials as a model. The Gadfly: Instantly lives up to the "Fine City" reputation by warning the other ASEAN members not to make a mess lest they'll be fined with a smug smile on his face. He then says that he's joking after the Philippines and Thailand respond with aBig "WHAT?!". Jerkass to One: While normally a friendly country, he is particularly hostile towards Malaysia. Might have something to do with them sharing the water bill, among other things.

characters.name: Malaysia
characters.description: Animal Motifs: Malaysia's hairstyle is partially inspired by his national animal, the Malayan tiger. Annoying Younger Sibling: Age-inverted; he eagerly wants Singapore to acknowledge him as his big brother despite the latter's refusal. Big Ol' Eyebrows: Has the thickest eyebrows among the ASEAN members courtesy of him being a former colony of England. Cloud Cuckoo Lander: Even more carefree than Thailand, to the point where the guy hasSkewed Priorities. Comically Missing the Point: Comes to the conclusion that Singapore isTsunderefor him after realizing that the latter has only shown his tourist smile to everyone other than him.

characters.name: Commonwealth of Australia
characters.description: Attention Deficit... Ooh, Shiny!: According to the Halloween 2013 event notes:"He's the kind of man who will be in the middle of having a conversation with someone one minute and instantly be chasing after a passing cat the next." Awesome Aussie: He can normally swim 10 kilometers:Australia:But I guess you can't really feel accomplished unless you swim at least the length of theDover Strait, huh? Battle Boomerang: One appeared in his sketch notes. Big Ol' Eyebrows:Even bigger than England's◊in the first sketch.A later pictureshows him with eyebrows that aren't as big as England's, but are still fairly big. Flipping the Bird: His koala does this in Volume 5. Maybe it took lessons from Mochimerica.

characters.name: New Zealand
characters.description: All There in the Manual: He didn't appear in any strip untilHetaween 2011. Ambiguous Gender: He was considered this for a long time, due to his design being considered cutesy and him not having made any significant appearances to denote a gender (along with his chest and body being concealed by a sheep at times). Himaruya's initial answer was borderingShrug of God, orcoming off more like a tease:Is New Zealand-san a man or a woman?New Zealand:Which do you think I am?There was also much debate over whether or not the usage of "seinen" in his manga profile indicated that he was unambiguously male, or whether seinen was being used in a gender-neutral context. However, theHetalia Hetaween 2013Event notes broke the ambiguity by outright referring to him as a man, and he also has a male seiyu in the anime. There was also much debate over whether or not the usage of "seinen" in his manga profile indicated that he was unambiguously male, or whether seinen was being used in a gender-neutral context. However, theHetalia Hetaween 2013Event notes broke the ambiguity by outright referring to him as a man, and he also has a male seiyu in the anime. Big Ol' Eyebrows:Fairly big eyebrows indeed◊. Idiot Hair:Two on either side of his head, like ram horns.◊

characters.name: Kingdom of Tonga
characters.description: Idiot Hair: Appears to have two in the same style as New Zealand; however, since they were dressed as a sheep in their only appearance, it may have been part of the costume. The Faceless: For the moment; in their only appearance they were seen from the back.

characters.name: Republic of Seychelles
characters.description: Annoying Younger Sibling: An adopted one of sorts towards England and France. But mostly England. Big Eater: Implied. In the 2010 Christmas Bloodbath, she was willing to eatFinland'scooking, and even asked for him to send her food in exchange for a photo. Cloudcuckoolander: Lampshaded in the 13th Birz chapter.Even though others are pretty sure they could never imitate her, she's such an airhead that one can't help worrying about her. Cool Sword: She gets one in her 2011 Halloween costume anda few sketches. Covert Pervert: Turns out that she really likes butts. (Or at least coconuts shaped like butts.)

characters.name: Republic of Cameroon
characters.description: Cute Kitten: Sort-of. He has a lion cub named Kokolo.Intellectual Animal: Kokolo is, apparently, a Glasgow University Fine Arts graduate. Intellectual Animal: Kokolo is, apparently, a Glasgow University Fine Arts graduate. Gentle Giant:The Christmas Specialmentions that he likes playing soccerwith the children of his country,and was exactly doing that when he was caught by "the mysterious figures". Kindhearted Cat Lover: He's aGentle Giantwho owns a pet lion cub. Perma-Shave: He even shaves an X on the side of his hair.

characters.name: Arab Republic of Egypt - Gupta Muhammad Hassan
characters.description: Cute Mute/The Quiet One: Egypt is not much of a talker. Though, at one point, France asked him if he could even talk, to which Egypt responded, "Would you like to buy something?"InFanonhe's often seen as a fourth wheel to the'Magic Trio'(England, Norway and Romania). InFanonhe's often seen as a fourth wheel to the'Magic Trio'(England, Norway and Romania). Flat Character: One of the most out of the series with little stand out qualities other than his muteness. Informed Attribute: Despite being mute, he's rumored to have been very talkativeaccording to a sketch. Non-Human Sidekick: His jackal hound,Anubis. Obviously namedafter the Egyptian god of the Dead.In his new profile picture, he has a falcon as well. Likely an allusion toRa, the falcon god of the Sun.

characters.name: Principality of Sealand — Peter Kirkland
characters.description: A sea fort that was neglected by England that became a nation before England knew what happened! He's an active boy with a really cheerful voice who's the self-proclaimed smallest nation in the world! England finds him irritating but that doesn't really concern Sealand at all. The Prince of Sealand always seems to go somewhere everyday so the soldiers left there look after Sealand while he's away. He may a small body, but it's entirely made of steel so he can shoot a Rocket Punch and also boast at a probably unreasonable level. Lately, he's been selling Noble Ranks to America and Japan, but he's still been doing pretty good. He prefers a pleasant internet. Now currently recruiting friends and countries that have recognized him as a country. His hobby is to play football with other nations that haven't been recognized too. Airplane Arms: Runs around his home this way. Annoying Younger Sibling: To England.

characters.name: Principality of Seborga
characters.description: A composed and carefree man that was originally an independent nation seated on a hilltop, before it became a part of Italy. When he declared independence, not only was there zero dispute between Italy and Seborga, but even today he still takes his duties, rights and freedoms as an Italian citizen seriously! When Seborga declared independence, Italy was receiving quite a few more tourists than usual, so they thought it'd be a good time for some good business. But not only did the people of Seborga not really want to do business, but the shops opened late and closed early and the people of Seborga continued to enjoy their calm, laid-back lifestyle during this period. Big Brother Mentor: To the rest of the Micronations. Chivalrous Pervert: As seen in the quote above, he flirts with girls a lot but passes Wy for being too young for him. He still promises to hit on her when she's an adult. Cloud Cuckoo Lander: If one doesn't consider his introduction where he's stuck in a tree upside-down while ketchup drips from his forehead while still being awfully cheerful strange, then what is? Dismotivation: Among all the Micronations, he actuallycouldtry to be officially independent but... it's just too much work, you know?

characters.name: Principality of Wy
characters.description: A mouthy little girl that decided to get her independence when Australia didn't allow "Prince" Paul Delprat have a road built. She was officially accepted and is now busy coming up with an anthem and a flag. She loves art and draws every single day. Closer to Earth:Wy:Hey, Sealand!Why are all boys so dumb? Fiery Red Head: Depending on if you see her hair color asbrown or auburn. Improbable Weapon User: Fanon sometimes will depict her as using the oversized paintbrush she carries in chibi illustrations as a weapon. She Cleans Up Nicely: Looksadorablewhen wearing a dress inHetaween 2011. Even more so in the micronation group picture linked up there.

characters.name: Republic of Kugelmugel
characters.description: A micronation created by an artist in Austria. His whole country is based on art. Maybe trying to gain independence is another form of art. The braids are art too! Adaptation Dye-Job: Has white hair in manga illustrations, while his anime appearance gave him platinum blond hair. Artistic License – History: At one point, Kugelmugel is depicted talking to his "king". The micronation was a republic, and thus never had a king. Dude Looks Like a Lady: His braids made him look more feminine and confused fans and nations alikeon his true gender. Girlish Pigtails: Wears braided twintails and overall looks so feminine that he has been mistaken for a girl by others.

characters.name: Republic of Molossia
characters.description: A mysterious country that lives an isolated life in one of America's inland states, Nevada. He is a very serious young man that is always collecting taxes from America, but he tries really hard to look like a bad guy on the outside. Only 10 people are allowed to go sight see his territory per year. If It's You, It's Okay: Implied, non-sexual and non-romantic example with Americaaccording to this new strip.◊Unlike everybody else, he is so used to see Molossia'sNice Guyside that he is surprised to see the micronation as aDelinquent. Then again, acting tough would be no use since America is way much stronger than him... Hidden Heart of Gold: He is aNice Guywhen he is alone, but when you enter his territory, he pretends to be a giant jerk.He even acts like aBig Brother Mentortowards the new micronation, Slowjamastan. He even acts like aBig Brother Mentortowards the new micronation, Slowjamastan. Sir Swears-a-Lot: When he acts like a jerk, he swears to the point of droppingCluster F-Bombs.

characters.name: Principality of Hutt River
characters.description: Wy's senior. He is always oddly dazzling and far too free-thinking. He is famous in Australia and his house is pretty complex for a micronation. Brought Down to Normal:Due to his leader's bankruptcy, he becomes a normal human. Hair Flip: At least three times in the manga that introduces him: twice when debating over Sealand's proposition to join his group of friends (the flipping-behing-the-ear variant then the tossing-in-the-air one) then another time at the end with the other micronations (again the flipping-behind-the-ear kind). You can conclude hair flipping is a habit of his. Land Down Under:Lampshadedby Wy of all people:Wy:...Hm? A Rolls-Royce? Incredible clean and organized facilities? A bilby? We're in Australia! Pimped-Out Cape: Like the rest of his outfit, it is part of his home's regalia (see link above, not the one about bilbies, the one above it), even though it is, along with the sash, of another colour.He even wears it over a swimsuit during the2011 Christmas event, when he hangs out with Wy, Australia and New Zealandon the beach.

characters.name: Republic of Nikko Nikko
characters.description: A micronation that tried to become independent from Japan. He used to be a mountain hot spring, but returned to being an ordinary Japanese person. He's an easygoing, quiet oddball who loves radium eggs. Brought Down to Normal: He voluntarily gave up his status as a micronation to live as a Japanese citizen once more.invokedWord of Godsays he still represents his micronation, but he ages like a normal person.When he shows up in Hetaween 2013, he's grown into an adult with a child of his own...while Sealand and Ladonia haven't changed at all. When he shows up in Hetaween 2013, he's grown into an adult with a child of his own...while Sealand and Ladonia haven't changed at all. I'm Standing Right Here: Sealand screams in pain after learning he went back to be a Japanese citizen, but Wy points out Nikko Nikko is just sitting behind him. Noodle Incident: Justhowhe went from a normal human to a nation in the first place is never explained. Japan is completely bewildered by it.Nikko Nikko:If you believe and try your best, your dreams will come true, won't they, Japan?Japan:What on Earth did you try your best at?!

characters.name: Ladonia
characters.description: An internet country created by Swedish technicians. He's a bit cheeky, but all in all a regular primary school kid. He is leading a fight with Sweden (or so he likes to think). Badass Adorable: Hethinkshe's this, because Sweden pretends to be defeated every time he attacks. Cyberspace: He exists in the internet apparently (and presumably in Sweden). Hologram: He has a "physical" form as long as his laptop is on. Facial Markings: He has a streak of paint across his right cheek and nose.

characters.name: Aerican Empire
characters.description: Mr. Imagination: The Aerican Empire believes a lot in imagination, it could well be that he runs on imagination. Proud to Be a Geek: If hislightsaberis an indication, and if his predilection for sci-fi is to be believed. Robot Buddy: Has a spherical robot that keeps in his hand. Apparently, this is modeled after the smiley face in his flag. You Are Better Than You Think You Are: Tells Hutt Riverthat he should not cease of thinking of himself as a nation, as Hutt River could still live on imagination.

characters.name: Republic of Slowjamastan
characters.description: Cool Bike: He made his entrance by riding on a motorcycle. Cute Little Fangs: Due to his raccoon motif, you can see his fangs are prominent. Younger Than They Look: He looks like a teenager but had only been established in 2021, making him only two years old. Wy was shock to find her junior doesn't fit her image of him.

characters.name: Ancient Italy/Roman Empire/Roman Republic
characters.description: Age Lift: "Grandpa Rome" in his waning days was originally portrayed as an old man, but in the anime he retains his youthful appearance during his time with Chibitalia. Lampshaded by the dub narrator, who refers to him as "[Italy's] unusually handsome grandfather." Boisterous Bruiser: And how. See Germania's quote, i.e. The Casanova: He does lovehanging out◊with beautiful ladies.◊ Doting Parent: To Italy. "Aww, he's sokyooot~" Dirty Old Man: The 'With Grandpa Rome' strips (in the published manga) hint on this.

characters.name: Greece/Byzantine empire
characters.description: Ambiguous Situation: She might not be the Byzantine Empire, though some earlier sources claimed her as such with Turkey killing her. Assimilation Backfire: A downplayed example. It is mentioned that while Rome might have made her a part of his Empire, she in turn conquered him with her culture and Gods in turn as an allusion to the Hellenization of the Roman Empire. Good Parents: She seems to have raised Greece right and he still loves her and takes care of her ruins many years after her death. Top Wife: She is mentioned as Rome's most important wife. Gorgeous Greek: She is absolutely stunning.

characters.name: Germania/Germanic Tribes
characters.description: Adaptation Dye-Job: He has blue-green eyes in manga illustrations, while in the anime they were made plain blue. Braids of Barbarism: He has braids, and since he represents the Germanic Tribes, he would definitely count. Bodyguard Betrayal: According to their profiles, he used to be Rome's bodyguard. Then he killed him. Disappeared Dad: In the drama CD he's called HRE's father. Perpetual Frowner: So much that, when hetriesto smile, he cannot.

characters.name: Ancient Egypt
characters.description: Ancient Egypt: Is thepersonificationof it. Kindhearted Cat Lover: She loves and dotes on cats, since she sees them as holy, to the point that she gets upset when Rome decides to keep one as a pet. Missing Mom: To her son, the current Egypt. Nice Girl: She's described as being laidback, lenient and a "likable" person. Occult Blue Eyes: Is depicted with these due to her penchant for sorcery.

characters.name: Persia/Persian Empire
characters.description: Dark and Troubled Past: He's said to have endured many hardships, which "carved out his current personality." Pride: He's described as being "self-assured," and heisrather smug when gloating to Rome about capturing his emperor. Rule of Cute: His profile mentions that Persian art sometimes uses "cute and fancy" art motifs. Vestigial Empire: He's said to have been in a similar situation to Rome, leaving behind many children and grandchildren.
